info.name: Cvent REST APIs — Event Cloud Video API

params.name: after
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated after this time point. Default to the beginning of time of the data store.

params.name: before
params.description: Used to query records that have been added or updated before this time point.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: token
params.description:
The continuation token returned from a previous class. This must be a valid UUID v4 if provided.
This will override any other pageable parameters provided.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Use filter query parameters to limit results
to data that matches your criteria. See
[Filters](https://developers.cvent.com/docs/rest-api/reference/filters) for details.

Supported fields and operators are listed below:

| Field        | Operators  | Notes                            |
|--------------|------------|----------------------------------|
| id           | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| events       | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| sessions     | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| exhibitors   | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| speakers     | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| source.id    | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| status       | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| tags         | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| recording.id | `eq`, `ne` |                                  |
| event.id     | `eq`, `ne` | deprecated, use `events` instead |

The following logical operators are supported for combining filters:
* and
* or

params.name: deleted
params.description: True means only videos marked as deleted will be queried. False means only non-deleted videos will be queried.

items.docs: Gets a paginated list of videos associated with your account or event.

items.docs: Gets a paginated list of video views
Gets a list of audio tracks for a specific video ID.
Gets a list of video renditions for a specific video ID.
Gets a list of video text tracks for a specific video ID.
Creates a new text track (VTT) object for a specific video. This endpoint does not directly handle the upload of VTT files but instead returns a location URL that you use to perform the upload.

params.name: textTrackId
params.description: The identifier of a video text track.

items.docs:
Updates a specific video text track by ID. This is done by setting the status to Updating within the body of this call,
which will prompt the service to return a signed upload link in the returned entity.
